column1: # docs/doc-budgets.tsv — byte ceilings, enforced by `scripts/doc-check.sh budget`.
# FORMAT: <path>\t<max_bytes>          (tabs, not spaces; # and blank lines ignored)
# WHAT BELONGS HERE, AND WHAT DOES NOT
# Ceilings apply to files whose bytes are paid repeatedly, or read first — three
# categories, not two: per-spawn, generated, and front-door. (This said "ONLY to
# per-spawn and generated files" while listing README.md, which is neither.)
#   CLAUDE.md   is injected into EVERY sub-agent spawn, so its size is multiplied
#               by every dispatch. That multiplication is the entire reason the
#               CONTEXT epic exists, which is why its ceiling was set AT the
#               file's size when the ratchet landed (28781 B at 0a9a674): a
#               ratchet, not headroom. It is the ONLY row set that way — SPEC.md
#               (6010 B) and README.md (7254 B) were given a round 8192 B, which
#               IS headroom. CLAUDE.md was 30063 B at 85ed77f, i.e. OVER by 1282 B
#               (do not trust that number: run `doc-check.sh budget`),
#               so `budget` exits 1 until it shrinks; that red is the ratchet
#               working. Do not raise the number, and do not delete the row —
#               deleting it turns the check green and leaves nothing to notice.
#               README.md sits 4 B under its ceiling (8188 B) as of 2026-08-21.
#   SPEC.md     is a generated mirror (scripts/gen-spec-mirror.sh), so growth here
#               is a generator change, not authorship.
#   README.md   is the first thing a new agent or human reads.
# EXEMPT BY DESIGN — deliberately absent from this file, recorded here so their
# absence reads as a decision rather than an oversight:
#   DECISIONS.md   append-only rationale. It is consulted by grep and range-read,
#   AGENT_LOG.md   never injected wholesale, so its bytes are paid once by the
#                  one agent that reads the relevant range — not per spawn. They
#                  are ~483 KB and ~364 KB respectively (2026-08-21; they were
#                  described here as ~400 KB and ~287 KB, which they outgrew)
#                  and SHOULD keep growing:
#                  capping them would delete the reasons this project has already
#                  been caught removing three times. Cut cost, not reasons.
#   CONTRACTS-*.md and PROTOCOL.md and AGENT_PROTOCOL.md are also uncapped for
#                  now: they are reference documents read by grep, not injected.
#                  Add them here only with evidence that something reads them
#                  whole.
CLAUDE.md
SPEC.md
README.md
